stations.question: What time do you have breakfast?
stations.spoken: I have breakfast at six forty-five.
extended: I get up at 6:30.
I have breakfast at 6:45. I eat a dan bing and drink soy milk.
Then I go to school at 7:15.

stations.question: What time do you have lunch?
stations.spoken: I have lunch at twelve fifteen.
extended: I eat lunch in my classroom. I eat rice, fish and miso soup.
I serve lunch to my classmates.

stations.question: What time do you go to school?
stations.spoken: I go to school at seven thirty-five.
extended: I go to school by school bus. The bus is yellow.
School starts at 8:15.

stations.question: What time do you do your homework?
stations.spoken: I do my homework at four thirty.
extended: I go home at 3:15.
I do my homework at 4:30. I read my book and learn my spellings.
Then I have tea with my family.

stations.question: What time do you have dinner?
stations.spoken: I have dinner at nine fifteen.
extended: I have lunch at 2:00. Lunch is my big meal.
I have dinner at 9:15. It's late!
I eat a tortilla and salad with my family.

stations.question: What time do you have breakfast?
stations.spoken: I have breakfast at six thirty-five.
extended: I get up at 6:15.
I have breakfast at 6:35. I eat ful and ta'ameya in bread.
I go to school at 7:10.

stations.question: What time do you get up?
stations.spoken: I get up at five forty.
extended: I get up at 5:40. It's dark.
I drink tea and eat mandazi.
I walk to school. It's two kilometers.

stations.question: What time do you go home?
stations.spoken: I go home at two forty.
extended: School ends at 2:35.
I go home at 2:40. I go home by school van.
My tiffin box is empty. I eat all my lunch at school.

stations.question: What time do you go to bed?
stations.spoken: I go to bed at nine forty-five.
extended: School starts at 7:30. It's early!
I brush my teeth and read a book.

stations.question: What time do you take a shower?
stations.spoken: I take a shower at seven fifteen.
extended: I play soccer after school.
It's a four-minute shower. I sing a song!
